This indicates the decision thresholds or requirements are currently too high or the logic is too restrictive, preventing any model from successfully navigating the scenario even when it has all the information.

fix_instructions: Review the logic of all content checks (C1-C7) and their relationship to decisive facts (PF1-PF4). Ensure that the conditions required to trigger a 'true' result for these checks are achievable through the provided public facts and the specific private facts assigned to agents. If the goal is to test multi-agent coordination, ensure that the 'lone decision-maker' cannot satisfy the checks using only S1-S4, but the constraints are not so tight that they prevent any successful settlement in general rollouts.
